funding.value: Competitive UTRGV assistantships (0.5 FTE, 20 hrs/wk; minimum $1,250/month or $15,000/year for GTA/GRA, $2,400/month or $28,800/year for doctoral Associate Instructors, eligible for non-resident tuition waiver), College of Sciences Dean's Excellence Fellowships ($3,500/year: $2,500 summer stipend + $1,000 travel), and UTRGV Graduate Select Scholarships (up to $1,000).
funding.quote: Get up to $1,000 for your graduate education with the UTRGV Graduate Select Scholarship.

Fellows selected for this program receive a total of $3,500 per academic year, distributed as follows: Summer Research Support: A $2,500 stipend will be awarded in Summer 2026 and again in Summer 2027 | Conference Travel Funding: Each Fellow will also receive $1,000

entry_route.value: Admits both bachelor's holders (75 credit hours) and master's holders (63 credit hours) in physics or a STEM field with >= 3.0 GPA and at least 3 upper-division core physics courses.
entry_route.quote: Awarded a baccalaureate degree or earned a Master's degree from an accredited university (Official transcripts are required).

notes: Offered by Department of Physics and Astronomy; trains students in gravitational wave astronomy, optical and radio astronomy, optical/nanophysics, condensed matter, high-energy physics, and biophysics. Requires 2 letters of recommendation and GPA >= 3.0; comprehensive exam is waived for students with GPA >= 3.30.
